name: What is the typical timeframe for granite countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for granite countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeframe for granite countertop installation, from template to completion, is usually 1-3 weeks. This includes the initial consultation, precise measurement and templating, fabrication of the granite slabs, and the final installation. Factors that can affect this timeline include the complexity of your kitchen layout, the availability of your chosen granite slab, and the current project queue. For a precise estimate, we provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation based on your specific project in the Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, Emeryville service area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Granite countertop installation typically takes 1-3 weeks from templating to completion, depending on complexity and material availability.
